relationships.evidence: Cornerstone lists CEDA as one of its maintained downloadable core datasets.
relationships.constraints: The enterprise CEDA service and public Open CEDA release have different terms.
relationships.validation_question: Preserve release, licence and distribution channel.

relationships.evidence: Cornerstone states that it maintains USEEIO and is unifying it with CEDA into a global open MRIO.
relationships.constraints: The combined model is not yet a completed release.
relationships.validation_question: Keep source-model identities and concordances in the combined release.
